decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line has a dedicated website page and several models, indicating strategic focus and likely continued acceptance.
The hyaluronic acid serum fits the natural skincare portfolio and has been on the market for two years, so it is too early to withdraw without clearer underperformance.
The cleansing oil was only launched in 2024 and is close to the established offer, so it deserves more time before considering withdrawal.
